g.text: Red marks GPU idle only. ECHO prepare, finalize and hint use a separate lane; other control activities are not highlighted.
Compute phases use color. H2D and D2H have separate lanes. Hatched fused compute + IO is active work, never idle.
Window ends at L2 last compute. Starts at L0 first compute, or earlier L0 history H2D for dense extend. Prefill uses only chunk 16.
Intrusive NSYS profile; displayed times are not independent benchmark times.
